draw_policy.default: frozen-instance-by-default: scripts/build_images.sh reads the Judge-only Infrathon asset judge/final_cases.json (INFRATHON_ASSETS_ROOT) unless FINAL_CASES_PATH names another instance; every host that builds from this tree evaluates the same cases
draw_policy.privacy: hidden shapes, row distributions and seeds are Judge-only; this manifest lists only opaque case IDs and families
draw_policy.redraw: a new plan is a NEW suite identity

edge_suite.privacy: Judge-only Infrathon asset judge/edge_cases.json (assets/manifest.json), staged mode 0600 into the root-only Judge build context with the scored cases, proven absent from every Work build context by scripts/validate_layout.py
edge_suite.semantics: untimed zero-weight hard gates: each case is called twice on one fresh guarded input set; complete writes, the exact FP8 reference (5e-5) and the BF16-source metric (1e-3 on slices of at least 16384 outputs) on every non-empty group, guard bands and byte-exact inputs; the sanitize subset is also run once under compute-sanitizer memcheck with the caching allocator disabled; v4 adds prefix-sum row offsets past 2^31 bytes, single groups, one hot group, all-empty calls, extreme hints and prefix-sum M_max up to 131072

selection_semantics: edge cases run first and must all pass; then all 1000 scored cases run, each also a correctness and memory-safety gate; a single-call case is the median of 5 trials, a sequence case the median of 3 rounds (total flops / round time); cases are geometrically averaged within each of the four families and the score is the geometric mean of the four family scores; finally the sanitizer subset runs under compute-sanitizer
timeout_semantics: suite gates and orchestration ceilings qualify the selected execution profile; they do not identify a GPU model

families.decode: small batches in both layouts; Dirichlet-skewed per-group rows, empty groups allowed; 100 of 500 cases carry a hint 1/8 to 8 times off; 500 cases
families.latency: one group (rows in a band up to 256) or very few rows across mostly empty groups; 200 cases
families.prefill: large batches in the prefix-sum layout; Dirichlet-skewed per-group rows; 200 cases
families.sequence: 58 layers x two linears = 116 consecutive calls per round, weights from an 8-layer pool fixed across rounds, fresh row counts per call, no synchronization between calls; 100 cases

workload.hint: max(1, int(1.2 * expected_m * hint_scale)); sequence: one hint per pooled layer, int(that * U(0.7, 1.3))
workload.provenance: suite plan v1 frozen 2026-11-07 (docs/scale_up/dynamic-fp8-suite-v1.json, Judge-only); calibrated synthetic row distributions, no captured routing trace
workload.row_counts: a pure function of the case seed: uniform int(expected_m * U(0.7, 1.3)), single-group band, or Dirichlet(alpha) split of expected_m * G clipped to M_max; the Judge recomputes every draw
workload.shapes: 20 (N, K) pairs from 10 public MoE model configurations, disjoint from the 10 public pairs; the hidden shapes are root-only
